dataset.disclosure: 온집(ONZIP)은 가상의 서비스입니다. 모든 상품, 가격, 리뷰 수, 게시글, 닉네임은 허구의 샘플 데이터입니다.
dataset.locale_note: All user-facing strings in natural Korean (product names like '클라우드 3인 패브릭 소파', nicknames like '초록집사'). Prices in realistic KRW for the category. Ratings are integers = stars*10 (e.g. 47 = 4.7).

entities.name: categories
entities.note: exactly: 소파/거실가구, 조명, 러그/카페트, 수납/정리, 침구, 홈데코 with slugs sofa, lighting, rug, storage, bedding, deco

entities.name: products
entities.note: 4 products per category; image must be exactly 'assets/prod-NN.jpg' with NN = 01..24 in order; brands are fictional Korean brands; tags are 2-3 short Korean keywords; make 3 products 품절임박 and 2 products 품절

entities.name: posts
entities.note: 집들이(home tour) posts; cover_image exactly 'assets/post-N.jpg' with N = 1..6; product_ids each reference 2-4 real product ids used in that home; summary is 2-3 warm Korean sentences
